verdict.rationale: Poly documents importing existing notes and memory archives into Poly Mind from Notion, Obsidian, Evernote, Bear and others. General file import from the local machine and cloud drives is also documented, so plain Markdown files can come in as files. The evidence does not say whether page hierarchy, internal links, or attachments survive the import, and Roam is not named. Missing for 10: Roam import, documented preservation of structure, links and attachments, details on how Markdown is handled, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of import fidelity.
